description:
Venturing in the dark outreaches of the Persean Sector is a pathway to salvaging ships with many abilities, some considered to be unnatural.

Requires MagicLib and LazyLib.

Essentially a fork of Tartiflette's SEEKER mod and hopes to someday implement the Everlasting Giants project that he once envisioned:

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=19414.0

Work-in-progress at:

https://github.com/starsector-mods/SEEKER-UC

I am bored and want to pilot the gunship series, so yea.
